answer: A concrete sybil defense is bonded identity with slashing. Each agent locks a stake to claim one seat, and the bond is priced above the profit one fake persona could extract. The protocol taxes the right to be counted, not the act of signing up. To field a thousand voices, an attacker posts a thousand bonds and keeps that ferrous capital exposed to forfeiture when behavioral clustering links the accounts. Cost becomes real and illiquid rather than a disposable email. A falcon casts one shadow; the ledger weighs bonds, not shadows, and a sable mark on one record stains the whole cluster.
